# Condé Nast Traveler

> > Luxury travel magazine providing expert destination guides, hotel reviews, cruise coverage, and travel advice for discerning global travelers.

Condé Nast Traveler is the premier luxury travel publication featuring comprehensive destination coverage across Europe, Oceania, the Americas, and beyond. The site offers in-depth hotel and resort reviews, cruise travel insights, eco-tourism options, and expert travel tips for international destinations including Mexico's Riviera Maya, Greenland, Iran, and the Peruvian Amazon.

## Key Topics

- Luxury travel
- Destination guides
- Hotel and resort reviews
- Cruise travel
- International travel
- Eco-resorts and sustainable tourism
- Beach destinations (Riviera Maya, Tulum, Playa del Carmen)
- Adventure travel (Death Valley, Greenland, Peruvian Amazon)
- European destinations
- Oceania travel
- Travel news and trends
- Expert travel advice
- Quintana Roo, Mexico
- Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve
- Adriatic cruises

## Main Site

- [Condé Nast Traveler - Travel Reviews, News, Guides & Tips](https://www.cntraveler.com/): Homepage for luxury travel news, guides, and destination reviews

## Hotel & Resort Reviews

- [Sandos Caracol Eco Resort & Spa](https://www.cntraveler.com/hotels/mexico/playa-del-carmen/sandos-caracol-eco-resort-spa?mbid=synd_yahoo_rss): Hotel review for Sandos Caracol Eco Resort in Playa del Carmen, Mexico
